title: Unified retry presets and ergonomics for generator stream surface (cross-SDK bumps)
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Teams reported inconsistent retry semantics and divergent ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs when using generator-style streaming and reauth flows. This resulted in surprising user-visible behavior during backoff, heartbeat-induced reauth, and stream consumer cancellation. This PR consolidates a small, well-documented set of retry presets and normalizes the generator/pullstream surface across the three SDKs, plus coordinated version bumps to keep package parity across releases.

What I did (summary): - Introduced a compact RetryPreset enum and a RetryPolicyFactory that maps presets to concrete backoff jitter, max attempts, and idempotency expectations. - Plumbed a light-weight RetryHints bag through the TypeScript generator stream adapter so consumers can opt-in to "latency-sensitive" or "cost-aware" presets without needing to craft exponential backoff boilerplate. - Harmonized the stream cancel semantics: generator consumers now receive a standardized CancelledError (with consistent shape across SDKs) and streams guarantee deterministic cleanup of in-flight heartbeats. - Improved reauth handoff hotspot: session refreshes now surface an optional prefetch window and a short circuit path for non-idempotent requests. - Coordinated package.json/pyproject.toml/go.mod version bumps: ts v1.27.3 -> v1.28.0, py 1.12.1 -> 1.13.0, go v0.9.7 -> v0.10.0.

Description (full): This change is intentionally conservative: the new RetryPreset exposes three named profiles (conservative, balanced, aggressive) and a small override surface for advanced users (maxAttempts, baseMs, jitter). The generator stream adapter accepts a retry preset in the options bag and emits structured telemetry events for every retry decision (retry.reason, retry.preset, attempt). I also standardized the SDKs' CancelledError message and added a short RFC-style doc in docs/streaming/retry-presets.md explaining expectations and migration notes.

Checklist: - [x] Add RetryPreset API and factory - [x] Wire preset through TS generator stream adapter - [x] Emit retry telemetry events - [x] Add CancelledError/cleanup guarantees tests - [x] Coordinate version bumps and changelogs for py/ts/go - [x] Update streaming docs and quickstarts

High-level commits: - 1f3d8c4 feat(retry): add RetryPreset and factory - 4a2b7e1 feat(stream): accept retryPreset in generator options - c9a2d21 fix(auth): short-circuit reauth for non-idempotent calls - d73b0e6 docs: add streaming/retry-presets.md and migration notes - b1e9f30 chore: bump TS version to v1.28.0 and update changelog

Files changed (high-level): - src/stream/generator.ts (TS): adaptor surface + retry plumbing - src/auth/session.ts (TS): prefetch window and short circuit path - docs/streaming/retry-presets.md: new RFC-style guide - test/stream/retry-presets.spec.ts: unit + integration harness - package.json / package-lock.json: version bump - ci/workflows/streaming-tests.yml: added matrix job for py/ts/go streams (basic interop smoke)

Testing notes: Unit and integration tests were added and run locally + in CI. The matrix job spins up minimal cross-SDK harness where a TS generator consumer connects to a mocked server which simulates transient 503s, token expiry during the stream, and slow heartbeats. Observed behavior: conservative preset keeps attempts low and surfaces retry telemetry; aggressive preset pushes to the retry ceiling but respects non-idempotent short-circuit.

Backwards compatibility and migration: Default preset is "balanced" and preserves previous retry behavior in 99% of cases. The migration doc lists the rare behavioral diffs when upgrading to v1.28.0 and provides a one-line opt-out.

Related: ENG-2145 (stream retry parity), ENG-2198 (cross-sdk version sync).

review_thread: Marco Rivera (review) - Request changes: prefer an explicit enum value rather than raw strings so downstream typing is stricter.
Aisha Patel (author) - Reply: switched to RetryPreset enum and added tests to assert type-safety in the TS build.
Jin Kim (review) - Comment: the short-circuit path looks good but add a microbenchmark note; wondered about added CPU in hot auth path.
Aisha Patel - Reply: added a microbenchmark in test/bench/auth_shortcircuit.md; measured <1% CPU delta in our stress harness.
Sophie Laurent - Approve with suggestions: small nit around error message wording; confirmed cross-sdk parity with Go and Python counterparts.
release_notes:
- Introduce RetryPreset (conservative/balanced/aggressive) and RetryPolicyFactory
- Generator stream adapter accepts retry presets and emits retry telemetry
- Standardized CancelledError shape across SDKs
- Short-circuit path for non-idempotent reauth during streams
- TS 1.27.3 -> 1.28.0, Python 1.12.1 -> 1.13.0, Go 0.9.7 -> 0.10.0
notes_for_backport: Backport to release/1.27 required only for TS critical bugfix in auth short-circuit; backport PR should exclude version bump and docs and include an adjusted test matrix.
changelog_entry: feat(stream): unify retry presets and normalize generator surface (cross-sdk, bump versions)
testing_commands: npm run test:stream && pytest tests/streaming && go test ./stream -run RetryPresets
risk_assessment: low-medium: surface changes are additive (retry presets) but behavior can change for edge-case retry semantics; mitigations: default preserves previous behavior and we added integration tests and telemetry.
notes: Coordinated with python and go SDK leads to publish synchronized releases within the same release window. Kept the TS API ergonomics small to avoid churn for downstream consumers.
